description: This file is a shell script used for diagnosing and managing status LEDs on an OpenWrt device, particularly for visual indications during different system states such as preinitialization, failsafe, or upgrade. It loads configuration files, extracts LED settings from JSON, and controls the LED states accordingly.

methods.name: preinit_match_diag_led
methods.description: Detects and sets the diagnostic LED during preinitialization based on board JSON configuration.

methods.name: match_diag_led
methods.description: Matches the diagnostic LED configuration from system config and sets the status LED accordingly.

methods.name: get_status_led
methods.description: Determines the current status LED based on system configuration or board JSON.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the LED state based on the system state parameter such as preinit, failsafe, upgrade, or done.
